claims.claim: A mention-market paper found that richer context improves forecasts, that market-conditioned prompting yields better-calibrated forecasts, and that MixMCP outperforms the market baseline.
claims.episode_span: Richer context consistently improves forecasting performance.
claims.source_title: Forecasting Future Language: Context Design for Mention Markets
claims.supporting_quote: In our experiments, we find three insights: (1) richer context consistently improves forecasting performance; (2) market-conditioned prompting (MCP), which treats the market probability as a prior and updates it using textual evidence, yields better-calibrated forecasts; and (3) a mixture of the market probability and MCP (MixMCP) outperforms the market baseline.

claims.claim: A paper on context-augmented language models found that adding alternative data, including prediction markets, improved firm-performance forecasts relative to either source alone and beat standard baselines across four commercial channels.
claims.episode_span: adding alternative data in context alongside other financial information improves the language model's forecasting relative to either source alone
claims.source_title: Making Alternative Data Work: Context-Augmented LLMs for Financial Forecasting
claims.supporting_quote: In our experiments, adding alternative data in context alongside other financial information improves the LLM's forecasting relative to either source alone, and these forecasts are more accurate than those of standard forecasting baselines.
